assertions: The evaluator derives current truth from explicit supersession, revocation, contest, expiry and scope relationships rather than latest-timestamp guessing.
Ten repository-native fixtures cover confirmed preference, explicit override, temporal supersession, conflict, missing facts, irrelevant similarity, scope isolation, expiry, revocation and contest.
A passing trace is deterministic and independent of case or reference ordering.
Missing ingestion, imprecise retrieval, wrong version selection, wrong decision and wrong utilization are attributed to separate stages.
Unknown or unresolved required facts produce abstain for recall and ask for action parameters.
The public surface contains only opaque references, digests, lifecycle metadata and normalized traces, not transcript, identity, provider route or natural-language answer text.
Evaluation never changes memory, writes knowledge, executes an action or grants authorization.
